Hyderabad Metro Phase I Takeover and Expansion Under Review

SBICAPS has been appointed to study the valuation of Hyderabad Metro's Phase I and the expansion plans for Phase II. This review has brought the potential takeover of Phase I back under consideration, with loan disbursement becoming uncertain. Civil society groups have voiced concerns, labelling the potential takeover a bailout and demanding transparency in the process.
